tools.name: find_gifts
tools.description: Search the curated Surprise Buddy database for gift ideas matching a recipient. Returns product cards with title, image, price, why-it-fits, and a clickable product URL. Country is required and is a hard filter — results are scoped to the marketplace + currency of that country.

params.name: age
params.description: Recipient age in years. Filters gifts whose age range covers this value.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of gifts to return (1–20, default 5).

params.name: gender
params.description: Recipient gender. Gifts tagged "unisex" are always included regardless of this value.

params.name: occasion
params.description: Occasion code. Common values: birthday | christmas | easter | valentines | mothers-day | fathers-day | wedding | anniversary | graduation. Locale-specific occasions are also supported (e.g. einschulun

params.name: interests
params.description: Interest/hobby tags used for soft-match scoring (more matches rank higher). Call list_supported_interests for the canonical vocabulary.

params.name: profession
params.description: Recipient profession used as an exact-match filter, e.g. "teacher", "developer", "chef", "athlete", "photographer", "gamer".

params.name: favorite_color
params.description: Recipient's favorite color. Only returns gifts that explicitly match this color; color-agnostic gifts are skipped when this filter is set.

params.name: budget_max_cents
params.description: Maximum budget in cents of the country currency (e.g. 10000 = 100.00 EUR for DE).

params.name: budget_min_cents
params.description: Minimum budget in cents of the country currency (e.g. 5000 = 50.00 EUR for DE).

tools.name: list_supported_countries
tools.description: List ISO-2 country codes that currently have at least one active gift entry in the database. Coverage grows over time.

tools.name: list_supported_occasions
tools.description: List occasion codes that have active gift entries, optionally narrowed to a specific country.

params.name: country
params.description: Optional ISO-2 country code to scope the result (e.g. "DE" returns Einschulung; "NL" returns Sinterklaas).

tools.name: list_supported_interests
tools.description: List the canonical interest/hobby tag vocabulary used by find_gifts.interests. Matches the tags shown in the website UI.

tools.name: list_supported_colors
tools.description: List the canonical favorite-color vocabulary used by find_gifts.favorite_color. Matches the color picker shown in the website UI.
